descriptionNow: Burger Box Big Mac is a detailed Containers & Storage asset built for professional 3D pipelines, available at $29. The polygon count is 2,748, spread over 2,744 vertices. Whether that fits depends on where it lands - an architectural still and a real-time walkthrough tolerate very different counts.

You get 4 maps at 4096 x 4096 - enough resolution to hold a close shot. Topology is kept deliberately simple where detail would not read on camera, which keeps the scene light without visibly cheapening the silhouette. Transforms are frozen and the hierarchy is shallow, which keeps the asset easy to instance across a large environment.

Buyers most often take it for technical visualization, architectural visualization and product rendering. Available since 2016, the model has been through several rounds of studio use. It works as warehouse and logistics set dressing, a game prop, or a product-rendering element.
